canonical_project: Google West Memphis / Project Pyramid Data Center Campus
owner: Google (Groot LLC permit applicant / project entity)
power_notes: Google says it will cover full energy costs and is collaborating with Entergy on a new 600 MW solar project; Entergy says the solar project is backed by 350 MW battery storage in Jefferson County. APSC docket 25-055-P approved the special rate contract on 2026-01-29; docket 25-054-U approved the Cypress Solar CECPN on 2026-03-03.

history.reason: Google and Arkansas EDC announced the West Memphis data center on 2025-10-02; Arkansas EDC describes Google as constructing the campus.

history.current: Google (Groot LLC permit applicant / project entity)
history.reason: Google official announcement confirms the owner/operator; USACE permit notice identifies Groot LLC as applicant.

contradictions: Capacity/load for the data center campus is not publicly disclosed in primary sources; 600 MW solar and 350 MW battery figures are supporting generation/storage resources, not confirmed campus IT or utility load capacity.
Some industry/local summaries describe a $10B or larger PILOT/buildout envelope, while Google's official 2025-10-02 announcement states a $4B Arkansas investment through 2027.
why_not_in_baseline: Not present in the 208 baseline canonical_project list; likely missed Arkansas Google cloud/AI campus, distinct from baseline AVAIO Little Rock project.
